xna-type.name: CleanContent
xna-type.summary: An MSBuild task for deleting all the intermediate and output files that were created by a previous Content Pipeline build operation.

constructor.summary: Instantiates a new instance of this MSBuild task for deleting all the intermediate and output files that were created by a previous Content Pipeline build operation.

property.name: BuildConfiguration
property.summary: Gets or sets the content build configuration name.

property.name: IntermediateDirectory
property.summary: Gets or sets the directory for storing temporary build files.

property.name: OutputDirectory
property.summary: Gets or sets the output directory for the final build results.

property.name: RootDirectory
property.summary: Gets or sets the base path for the entire content build process.

property.name: TargetPlatform
property.summary: Gets or sets the content build target platform.

property.name: TargetProfile
property.summary: This property is available only when developing for Windows.

method.name: Execute
method.summary: Removes all intermediate and output files that were created by a previous Content Pipeline build operation.

overload.summary: Removes all intermediate and output files that were created by a previous Content Pipeline build operation.
overload.returns: true if errors were logged; false otherwise.
